WV6-T01.5.note: The narrator tells strangers about carrying every stick of wood without being asked and tells it well, which shows pride in the jar and in the part he played; the self-aware wording is a little wry but does not amount to amusement at the jar.

exclusions.A: The council answered within a fortnight.
exclusions.C: Councils are seldom quick to admit that a scheme meant to protect wildlife did the opposite; this one said so in its first statement, covered the cost from its own budget, and asked Brill to keep counting.
exclusions.E: Councils are seldom quick to admit that a scheme meant to protect wildlife did the opposite; this one said so in its first statement, covered the cost from its own budget, and asked Brill to keep counting.

WV6-T02.5.note: The author sets the council apart from councils that are slow to admit mistakes, praising how fast it answered, how openly it admitted the error and how it paid for the fix, which is an approving attitude.
